description:
Additional studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
To get your Bible questions answered on a future program write to: tv@sumtv.org.

In this Bible Q & A program the following questions will be answered:

- Will humans loose the ability to procreate when they receive their immortal bodies?

- In the last days there will be a law compelling the observance of Sunday worship, and that those who will choose to observe that law (Sunday law) will have the mark of the beast. I've heard many pastor including yourself (Bohr) say that the mark of the beast has not yet come. This in my view gives the impression that for now it is ok to worship on Sunday. Doesn't this somewhat water down the first angels message to fear God and worship the creator? In my testifying to non Adventists, I urge them to make the decision now because they don't know when they may die, and therefore should not wait until the law comes. If after knowing the truth, and refusing to stop Sunday worship they die, they would have died with the mark of the beast. Is it wrong to testify thus?

- How do you explain Ephesians 2:15?
